ArtefactRef.description: A file an experiment read or wrote besides its datasets (gitma2, schema 0.17.0).

role.description: What the file is, e.g. "prediction cache", "export conformance results".

ArtefactRef.title: ArtefactRef

ChangeDecision.description: The single change of the iteration's change round, fixed from validation evidence and committed before phase B trains (spec 003 R5).

carried_model.description: G4: the manifest id of the one carried network (Annex B §B.4); tma-g4 refuses network predictions from another model.

carried_models.description: G5 (spec 012, schema 0.16.0): the manifest ids of the carried trackers (one or both of T1 and T2, Annex C §C.5), each with its own plan in `plans`, in the same order; tma-g5 refuses tracker predictions from any other model.

fresh_test_count.description: The dataset count whose test split a re-score scores (the plan's dataset.fresh_test.count; schema 0.11.1); tma-g2 refuses a plan with another count.

model_digests.description: The frozen carried models a re-score scores, by manifest id, with the SHA-256 of each one's weights.bin, manifest.json and model.json; tma-g2 refuses a re-score whose carried set or any of those files differs.

plan.description: The plan this decision pre-registers (configs/<…>/plan.json). Required from iteration 3 (spec 007): tma-g2 scores a test split only with the decision that names its plan.

plans.description: G5: the plan of each carried tracker (configs/phase4/<x>/plan.json), in the order of carried_models; they share one dataset and one fresh test seed.

reference_estimator.description: G4 (spec 010, schema 0.13.0): the frozen reference tracker's estimator name, which encodes every tuning parameter (e.g. imm-cv0-ct0.03-w0.003-s0.0001-r4); tma-g4 refuses reference predictions with another name.

rescore_of.description: The experiment directory of the inconclusive gate this decision re-scores (SRD §7: one re-score on a larger fresh-seed test set; e.g. experiments/20261024-i4-g2). When present, tma-g2 runs in re-score mode (--rescore-of): the frozen carried models are bound by model_digests instead of by training ancestry, the re-scored gate must be inconclusive and not itself a re-score, and the fresh test seed must differ from its test seed.

stalled.description: Any gated criterion failed or was inconclusive on validation.

test_seed.description: Dataset seed of the test split the decision commits to (the plan's fresh_test seed, or its dataset seed); tma-g2 checks it against the plan.

ChangeDecision.title: ChangeDecision

CheckpointMeta.description: The state beside a checkpoint's weights (spec 003 FR-015).
CheckpointMeta.title: CheckpointMeta

Continuation.description: The committed model a seeded continuation started from (scripts/train-continue.mjs; spec 003 decision 14, spec 004 decision 15). Its epoch records up to best_epoch are kept in the continued run's manifest, with their val_loss as recorded under the earlier config.

git_commit.description: The source model's training-code commit, when it recorded one.

rescored_val_loss.description: The source's best weights re-scored under the continued run's loss, written by tma-train when it resumed (spec 004 FR-002). With best_epoch and best_val_loss it makes the kept weights auditable: a run whose best_epoch is the source's must have best_val_loss equal to this value and weights_digest equal to the source's.

val_loss.description: The source's best-epoch validation loss under the source's config.

weights_digest.description: SHA-256 of the weights the continuation resumed from (the source's best epoch).

Continuation.title: Continuation

CrbHeader.description: First record of a tma2-crb file (gitma2).
CrbHeader.title: CrbHeader

CrbModel.description: Which model the Cramér–Rao bound assumes (gitma2, references/crb.py).
CrbModel.title: CrbModel

CrbRecord.description: Cramér–Rao bounds at the truth for one scenario's scored rows (zig_index + 1 … end); where the information is singular the bounds are 0 and singular is true (gitma2).

first_row.description: Row index of the first entry.

CrbRecord.title: CrbRecord

CurvePoint.description: One point of an error-vs-time-since-zig curve (curves.csv row).

efficiency_range.description: Range efficiency at this time, defined as in MetricsRecord (gitma2).

efficiency_speed.description: Speed efficiency at this time, defined as in MetricsRecord (gitma2).

range_rel_median.description: Absent when not finite (more than half the rows non-converged), as in MetricsRecord.

CurvePoint.title: CurvePoint

DatasetHeader.description: First record of every dataset file.

created_by.description: Command line that produced the file.

generator_git_commit.description: Commit of the checkout that ran tma-generate (absent before schema 0.8.0).

generator_git_dirty.description: True when that checkout had uncommitted changes (only allowed with --allow-dirty; absent before schema 0.8.0).

DatasetHeader.title: DatasetHeader

digest.description: SHA-256 of the dataset file (absent in manifests written before schema 0.4.0).

ExperimentManifest.description: Everything needed to reproduce an experiment run.

git_dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes (absent before schema 0.4.0).

node_version.description: Node.js version that ran the experiment (byte identity is promised per pinned Node).

python_version.description: Python version that ran the experiment (gitma2, schema 0.17.0).

torch_version.description: PyTorch version that ran the experiment, when a physics layer or model was used (gitma2).

ExperimentManifest.title: ExperimentManifest

FeatureLayout.description: Documents the model tensors (not stored as records). inputs [N, 240, 10]: bearing_sin, bearing_cos, own_x_km, own_y_km, own_course_sin, own_course_cos, own_speed_scaled, time_scaled, valid, window_mask; the derived feature set appends bearing_rate_scaled, rate_valid, intercept_scaled [N, 240, 13]. targets [N, 240, 6]: log_range_km, course_sin, course_cos, speed_scaled, x_km, y_km. loss_mask [N, 240]: window_mask and t ≥ zig_time. Features file format 2 also embeds the source DatasetHeader and the source dataset SHA-256.
FeatureLayout.title: FeatureLayout

Gate1Decision.description: The Gate 1 decision record (spec 003 FR-016, FR-021), committed before training: what is trained, how the carried weights are chosen, what is scored on test, and what follows.

validation_rule.description: When validation stops the phase before test.

Gate1Decision.title: Gate1Decision

ci_high.description: Upper bound of the bootstrap interval.

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the bootstrap interval.

threshold.description: Limit the statistic is tested against.

threshold_low.description: Lower limit, for a check that passes inside an interval (gitma2).

GateVerdict.description: Machine verdict for a gate; the team review records the final decision.
GateVerdict.title: GateVerdict

ManoeuvreKind.description: What a target manoeuvre changes (generator 0.5.0, SRD Annex C §C.2).
ManoeuvreKind.title: ManoeuvreKind

ManoeuvreSpan.description: Where one target manoeuvre lies in a scenario's samples (generator 0.5.0).
ManoeuvreSpan.title: ManoeuvreSpan

MetricsRecord.description: Metric values for one estimator on one slice at one evaluation point.

crb_course_deg_median.description: Median Cramér–Rao bound on course error (degrees).

crb_range_rel_median.description: Median over the slice's rows of the Cramér–Rao bound on relative range error (gitma2, schema 0.17.0; absent when no row has a regular bound).

crb_singular_rate.description: Fraction of the slice's rows where the Fisher information is singular (no bound).

crb_speed_kt_median.description: Median Cramér–Rao bound on speed error (knots).

efficiency_course.description: As efficiency_range, for course error ÷ the row's course bound.

efficiency_range.description: Median over rows with a regular bound of (range error ÷ that row's range bound), divided by 0.6745 so that an unbiased estimator at the bound scores 1 (gitma2). A flat value across geometry slices marks an approximation floor rather than missing information.

efficiency_speed.description: As efficiency_range, for speed error ÷ the row's speed bound.

non_converged_rate.description: Fraction of rows with no estimate (scored +∞; explains absent medians/P90).

position_m_mean.description: Mean position error over converged rows (non-converged rows count in gross_error_rate).

position_window_m_median.description: Median over scenarios of each scenario's mean position error over its predicted rows (time-late window-mean position, SRD §5; reported, not gated).

position_window_m_p90.description: 90th percentile over scenarios of the same per-scenario mean.

MetricsRecord.title: MetricsRecord

ModelDigest.description: A trained model named by its manifest id and the SHA-256 of its files (schema 0.11.0; manifest and model.json digests from 0.11.1).

model_json_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the model's model.json, its topology (schema 0.11.1).

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the model's weights.bin; equals its manifest weights_digest.

ModelDigest.title: ModelDigest

ModelManifest.description: Everything needed to reproduce and identify a trained model.

best_val_loss.description: The validation loss a later epoch must beat, under this manifest's config: the best epoch's val_loss, or, after a continuation changed the loss, the best weights re-scored under the new loss (spec 004 FR-002). Persisted so a chained job resumes against the same value. Absent before schema 0.8.2 (then the best epoch's recorded val_loss).

complete.description: False while training is in progress (checkpoint).

continued_from.description: Present when the run was seeded from a committed model (absent before schema 0.8.2).

g0_experiment.description: Id of the G0 experiment whose verdict the training guard accepted.

git_commit.description: Commit of the training code, read when training started (absent before schema 0.6.0).

git_dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes when training started (absent before schema 0.6.0).

source_dataset_header.description: Header of the dataset the train features came from (lineage; absent before schema 0.8.0).

tf_interop_threads.description: TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS in force when training ran (absent: unset).

tf_intraop_threads.description: TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS in force when training ran (absent: unset, so the TensorFlow default of one per core).

ModelManifest.title: ModelManifest

NaiveMeans.description: Training-set means used by the naive baseline for one prediction mode.
NaiveMeans.title: NaiveMeans

NaiveModel.description: Naive baseline (SRD §5): predicts training-set means. final uses each scenario's last-sample label; per_timestep uses every post-zig label.
NaiveModel.title: NaiveModel

NormalisationConstants.description: Fixed scaling constants computed from the train split's input channels only.

bearing_rate_scale_rad_s.description: 90th percentile of |trailing least-squares bearing rate| over train inputs; required for the derived feature set.

NormalisationConstants.title: NormalisationConstants

Observation.description: One bearing from ownship to target. Stone Soup analogue Detection. When valid is false (dropout) bearing_rad is 0 and must be ignored.
Observation.title: Observation

OutputParameterisation.description: How the model's four output channels encode the target's course and speed (spec 008).
OutputParameterisation.title: OutputParameterisation

PairedComparison.description: A model and a reference estimator compared on rows both answered (converged and finite), with each estimator's coverage reported separately (spec 003 R9).
PairedComparison.title: PairedComparison

ParameterRanges.description: Ranges from which ScenarioParameters are drawn. Initial ownship course, target bearing and target course are always uniform on [0, 2π); zig sign is uniform ±.

los_offset_rad.description: Angle off the line of sight, on the other bow, after an across_los turn; required when zig_rule is across_los.

min_range_m.description: Geometries closer than this at any sample are redrawn.

noise_sigma_rad_values.description: σ drawn uniformly from this set.

ownship_turn_rate_rad_s.description: Turn rate drawn uniformly per scenario; absent means an instantaneous zig.

target_course_change_count_weights.description: Generator 0.5.0 (SRD Annex C §C.2): probabilities of 0, 1, 2, … target course changes (summing to 1). Present: every scenario draws its manoeuvres this way, with target_manoeuvre_angle_abs_rad, target_turn_rate_rad_s, target_manoeuvre_after_zig_s and target_manoeuvre_margin_s, and target_manoeuvre_fraction must be absent.

target_manoeuvre_after_zig_s.description: Earliest start of the target's turn, after the first sample on leg 2.

target_manoeuvre_angle_abs_rad.description: Absolute target course change; the sign is uniform ±.

target_manoeuvre_fraction.description: Probability a scenario's target makes one course change (generator 0.4.0, SRD Annex B §B.2); absent means the target always holds course, as generators 0.1.0–0.3.0. When present, every scenario draws the manoeuvre parameters (so the PRNG is consumed alike) and the window must fit a turn whether or not one is made.

target_manoeuvre_margin_s.description: Least time from the end of the target's turn to the end of the window, so the gate point (manoeuvre + 5 min) is reached.

target_manoeuvre_spacing_s.description: Least time from the end of one target manoeuvre to the start of the next.

target_speed_change_abs_mps.description: Absolute speed change; its sign is uniform ±, flipped if the new speed would leave target_speed_mps (redrawn if both signs would).

target_speed_change_fraction.description: Probability of one target speed change (generator 0.5.0).

target_speed_change_rate_mps2.description: Magnitude of the target's acceleration during a speed change.

target_turn_rate_rad_s.description: Target turn rate, drawn uniformly per scenario.

zig2_delay_s.description: Delay from the start of leg 2 to the second turn; absent means one zig. The second zig follows zig_rule (and uses the same turn rate as the first).

zig_rule.description: How each zig is chosen; absent means random (generators 0.1.0–0.2.0). Under across_los zig_angle_abs_rad is still drawn but not used.

ParameterRanges.title: ParameterRanges

PhysicsHead.description: How a gitma2 model produces its estimate (spec 003).
PhysicsHead.title: PhysicsHead

PhysicsModelConfig.description: One gitma2 model's hyperparameters (spec 003 FR-010): encoder, heads, physics layer, loss, data sampling and optimiser; carried in its manifest.

causal.description: Causal encoder and physics layer up to the row (instantaneous); false is the time-late control.

loss_cap.description: Cap on a row's normalised squared error.

loss_init_weight.description: Weight of the auxiliary initial-state loss.

PhysicsModelConfig.title: PhysicsModelConfig

PlatformState.description: One platform state. Stone Soup analogue GroundTruthState.
PlatformState.title: PlatformState

Prediction.description: One estimator's output for one scenario.
Prediction.title: Prediction

PredictionHeader.description: First record of every prediction file.
PredictionHeader.title: PredictionHeader

PredictionRow.description: An estimator's target estimate at one timestep.

log_range_sd.description: Standard deviation of the estimator's log range (natural log; about the relative range error), from a velocity_gaussian network (spec 012). Absent for other estimators.

p_manoeuvre.description: The estimator's probability that the target's turn has started by this timestep (velocity_two_hypothesis networks only; spec 011). Absent for other estimators.

vx_sd_mps.description: Standard deviation of the estimated east velocity (velocity_gaussian only).

vy_sd_mps.description: Standard deviation of the estimated north velocity (velocity_gaussian only).

PredictionRow.title: PredictionRow

RecordKind.description: Discriminator for records in NDJSON files.
RecordKind.title: RecordKind

RunEnvironment.description: Software and hardware an experiment ran on (gitma2, schema 0.17.0).
RunEnvironment.title: RunEnvironment

Scenario.description: One ownship-vs-target run over a window.
Scenario.title: Scenario

ScenarioMetadata.description: Seed, parameter draws and derived slicing keys for one scenario.

manoeuvre_index.description: First timestep after the target's turn completes (generator 0.4.0; absent when the target holds course). Gate G4 counts time from here, as earlier gates count from zig_index. Under generator 0.5.0, after the last manoeuvre completes.

manoeuvre_start_index.description: First timestep after the target's turn starts (generator 0.4.0; absent when the target holds course). Under generator 0.5.0, after the first manoeuvre starts.

manoeuvres.description: Generator 0.5.0: each target manoeuvre's sample span, in time order (present, possibly empty, only under 0.5.0).

seed.description: Scenario seed as a decimal uint64 string.

turn2_start_index.description: First timestep after the second turn starts (absent with one zig or no turn rate).

turn_start_index.description: First timestep after the turn starts (absent for an instantaneous zig).

zig2_index.description: First timestep on leg 3, after the second turn completes (absent with one zig). Gate times still count from zig_index.

zig_index.description: First timestep on leg 2 (with a rate-limited turn, the first after it completes).

ScenarioMetadata.title: ScenarioMetadata

ScenarioParameters.description: The random draws that define one scenario.

ownship_turn_rate_rad_s.description: Ownship turn rate at the zig (rate-limited turn, spec 003 US6). Absent or 0: the course changes instantaneously, as in generator 0.1.0.

target_manoeuvre_angle_rad.description: Signed target course change; positive is clockwise.

target_manoeuvre_time_s.description: Target course change (generator 0.4.0, SRD Annex B §B.2): time the target's turn starts, a whole number of samples. Absent: the target holds course.

target_manoeuvres.description: Target manoeuvres in time order (generator 0.5.0, SRD Annex C §C.2), none overlapping. Present (possibly empty) only under generator 0.5.0 ranges; then the single-turn fields above are absent.

target_turn_rate_rad_s.description: Target turn rate through its course change.

zig2_angle_rad.description: Signed course change at the second zig; positive is clockwise.

zig2_delay_s.description: Second zig (generator 0.3.0, spec 007): time from the first sample on leg 2 to the start of the second turn. Absent: one zig, two legs.

zig_angle_rad.description: Signed course change at the zig; positive is clockwise.

zig_fraction.description: Zig time as a fraction of the window.

ScenarioParameters.title: ScenarioParameters

Split.description: Dataset split. Train/validation/test are 80/10/10 by scenario index.
Split.title: Split

TargetManoeuvre.description: One target manoeuvre (generator 0.5.0). A course change is an arc at constant speed; a speed change is constant acceleration on a constant course.

change.description: Signed change: course in rad (positive clockwise) or speed in m/s (positive faster).

rate.description: Magnitude of the rate of change, rad/s (course) or m/s² (speed).

start_time_s.description: Time the manoeuvre starts, a whole number of samples.

TargetManoeuvre.title: TargetManoeuvre

Track.description: Time-ordered states of one platform. Stone Soup analogue GroundTruthPath.
Track.title: Track

TrainingConfig.description: Hyperparameters and seeds for one training run (SRD §4; constitution III).

feature_set.description: Input channel set; absent means raw. Must match the features files.

layers.description: Stacked layers: causal CNN conv layers (no dilation; default 3), or recurrent layers for instantaneous and time_late (default 1; each returns sequences; spec 003 R20).

length_bucketing.description: Length bucketing (research R15; default false). Each group of bucket_batches batches of the epoch's seeded permutation is sorted by valid length, cut into batches whose rows are trimmed to the longest window, and the batch order is shuffled with a seed derived from train_seed and the epoch. The model takes a variable time dimension. Not for mlp.

loss_weight_manoeuvre.description: Weight of the turn-probability cross-entropy term (velocity_two_hypothesis only; spec 011). Absent means 1.

output_parameterisation.description: Output encoding; absent means course_speed. With velocity, loss_weight_speed weights each velocity component and loss_weight_course is unused (spec 008).

patience.description: Epochs without validation improvement before stopping.

tfjs_threads.description: TensorFlow intra-op and inter-op thread count, set by tma-train through TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS and TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS before tfjs-node loads. Absent: the TensorFlow default (one per core) or whatever the environment sets.

train_limit.description: Use only the first N training scenarios (tests and smoke runs).

train_seed.description: Decimal uint64; derives initializer seeds and batch order.

units.description: LSTM units (per direction), conv filters or dense width.

velocity_scale_mps.description: Velocity scale in m/s for the velocity parameterisation (required with it): the top of the generator's target speed range, a constant of the problem, never a truth statistic.

TrainingConfig.title: TrainingConfig

TrainingPlan.description: A plan branch's content (spec 003): the data, the models and the decision it implements.

decision.description: Path of the decision record it implements.

train_seed.description: Generator seed of the on-the-fly training stream.

TrainingPlan.title: TrainingPlan

ZigRule.description: How each zig's direction and size are chosen (generator 0.3.0, spec 007).
ZigRule.title: ZigRule
